verdict: Ads have been paused since mid-September; no new leads are running.
narrative: All paid campaigns stopped on September 16 and have not run since, meaning the 16 leads and $321.65 in spend reflected in this period are entirely from before that date. Of the 16 leads captured, none have converted into activated subscribers — the metric that matters most to your business — and no appointments were booked. Google Ads spent $70.38 over the 28-day window with zero conversions; that budget is being reviewed for pause. Campaigns will relaunch once the foundational setup items — landing pages, conversion tracking, and creative — are in place, at which point you should see lead flow resume with a tighter feedback loop between ad spend and actual activations.
